stepNotes.1: Single-file unit: packages/ax-code/src/perf/native.ts (185 lines). Exports NativePerf namespace (9 fns) + NativePerfSnapshot type. 15+ sibling consumers identified via grep across config, file, code-intelligence, debug-engine, and CLI layers.
stepNotes.2: No network/fs/db surface. Writes only to in-memory Map (line 29) and optional process.stderr (line 163). Byte accounting stores sizes only, never payload contents, so no secret-shape persistence. Native crash can lose the exit-time flush; acknowledged pattern in flag.ts:124-127.
stepNotes.3: run/runAsync error paths (lines 89-92, 106-109) re-throw after recording fails counter. get-then-set in record() (lines 52-69) is atomic in Node's event loop. snapshot() zero-guards avgMs (line 117). bytes() try/catch (lines 43-47) degrades circular input to 0 rather than throwing into a hot path.
stepNotes.4: record() invoked after performance.now() delta computed, so bytes() serialization cost does NOT inflate totalMs. However it does inflate wall-clock latency of every profiled dispatch on hot paths (code-intelligence/native-store.ts:50, file/ignore.ts:33). render() default param (line 142) materializes snapshot even when disabled. Both Medium, gated off by default.
stepNotes.5: namespace pattern matches AGENTS.md convention. Stat/Row/Snapshot type layering (lines 4-27) minimal and coherent. install() idempotent via ready guard (line 170). ready is one-shot with no teardown — latent exit-listener leak in embedded hosts. Imports only Flag + FeatureFlag, no cycles.
stepNotes.6: No empty error-swallowing catches (the one try/catch at 43-47 is intentional best-effort). No TODOs, no dead branches, no orphaned exports. formatMs used exactly twice. bytes() mixes per-item array recursion with whole-object JSON.stringify — inconsistent but not worth consolidating.
stepNotes.7: Direct test (test/perf/native.test.ts, 57 lines) covers run success, run failure-as-fails, and render output. Gaps: runAsync untested; install/flush/enable lifecycle and exit-flush path untested; bytes() branches (ArrayBuffer, typed-array, circular) untested; reset only exercised as cleanup.
